mapper.select: select bm_ingredient_plan.id, bm_ingredient_plan.name, (select count(1) from bm_ingredient_plan_material_batch where ingredient_plan_id = bm_ingredient_plan.id) plan_batch_count, (select count(1) from bm_ingredient_weigh_batch_process where ingredient_plan_id = bm_ingredient_plan.id) weigh_batch_count from bm_ingredient_plan where bm_ingredient_plan.completed = true and bm_ingredient_plan.is_deleted = 0 and bm_ingredient_plan.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} and bm_ingredient_plan.batch_no = #{batchNo} order by bm_ingredient_plan.name;

select distinct bm_ingredient_plan.id, bm_ingredient_plan.name from bm_ingredient_plan left join bm_ingredient_weigh_process on bm_ingredient_plan.id = bm_ingredient_weigh_process.ingredient_plan_id and bm_ingredient_weigh_process.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_ingredient_input_record on bm_ingredient_input_record.ingredient_plan_id = bm_ingredient_weigh_process.ingredient_plan_id and bm_ingredient_input_record.is_deleted = 0 where bm_ingredient_plan.is_deleted = 0 and bm_ingredient_plan.completed = true and bm_ingredient_plan.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} and bm_ingredient_input_record.id is null order by bm_ingredient_plan.name
